themes.description: Suggestions for new functionalities, integrations, or improvements to existing features within the platform or app.
Requests for additional news, market data, educational content, or information within the app.
Requests or feedback related to managing investments, modifying orders, or features for portfolio adjustments.
This theme covers feedback related to the availability of specific investment products, market access, or trading instruments.
Concerns or suggestions related to the application's user interface, visual design, layout, and overall user experience.
Issues related to order placement, trade execution, slippage, price discrepancies, and the reliability of trading operations.
This theme covers complaints about features that are absent from the application or platform, which users expect to be present. It includes requests for new functionalities.
Addresses suggestions or issues concerning general application features, usability, or missing functionalities.
Covers questions or feedback related to available investment products, types of investments, and account requirements for specific investment vehicles.
This theme covers questions or issues related to account setup, different investment types, and eligibility criteria.
This theme addresses concerns or requests regarding the range and types of investment products offered on the platform.
This theme covers general feedback on the app's usability, design, interface, and overall satisfaction.
This theme covers feedback, complaints, or concerns related to the financial returns, losses, or overall performance of investments.
Covers feedback on the app's ease of use, interface, design, and overall user experience.
Overall positive or neutral comments about the service that do not fit into specific predefined themes.
General feedback on the app's usability, design, and overall user experience, including positive comments.
Reviews expressing satisfaction, appreciation for improvements, or general positive sentiment about the app or service.
This theme includes feedback on the app's ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall user experience, including positive comments about simplicity or suitability for specific user groups.
This theme addresses user complaints regarding the frequency, intrusiveness, or relevance of advertisements displayed within the application.
Comments regarding the application's appropriateness for specific user groups, such as beginners or advanced users.
Complaints or feedback related to the presence, frequency, or intrusiveness of advertisements within the application.
General positive or negative feedback about the application that doesn't fit into more specific functional themes.
Concerns related to the platform's legitimacy, security, risk of funds, or overall trustworthiness.
This theme covers user suggestions for new features or enhancements to existing functionalities within the application.
This theme covers feedback related to the financial products offered, such as interest rates, investment options, or specific product terms.
This theme covers requests for more detailed information, better reporting, or improved transparency regarding investment details, account statements, or financial products.
This theme covers issues related to logging in, account verification, password resets, or any problems preventing users from accessing their accounts.
Issues or feedback related to initial account creation, KYC, signature verification, and other steps required to complete the setup process.
